# MacPair

> Open-source, native Mac remote desktop host with Mac and iPhone/iPad clients. Local-first, peer-approved, website-distributed, and controllable by a machine-readable CLI.

Canonical name: MacPair
Host app: MacPair Host
Client app: MacPair
iOS client: MacPair for iPhone and iPad
Website: https://mesut.uk/apps/macpair
Source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/macpair
License: Apache-2.0
Minimum macOS: 13.0
Host download: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/macpair/releases/download/v1.0.10/MacPair-Host-1.0.10-build-11.dmg
Mac client download: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/macpair/releases/download/v1.0.10/MacPair-1.0.10-build-11.dmg
iOS client download: https://mesut.uk/MacPair-iOS-1.0.5-build-6-unsigned.ipa
Integrity files: append .sha256, .manifest.json, or .sbom.cdx.json to a download URL
Mac signing: ad-hoc; current Mac downloads are not Apple-notarized
iOS signing: unsigned; a sideload tool must re-sign the IPA with the installer's Apple ID/team

## Agent quick start

screenharbor ensure
screenharbor status --json
screenharbor pending --json
screenharbor approve-pairing --fingerprint <verified-hex>

Never approve an unknown device. Show the user the pending display name and fingerprint and require an exact verified fingerprint.
Never disable Gatekeeper. A human must grant Screen Recording and Accessibility in
System Settings.

## Stable identifiers

Host bundle ID: uk.mesut.screenharbor.host
Client bundle ID: uk.mesut.screenharbor.client
iOS client bundle ID: uk.mesut.screenharbor.ios
Minimum iOS/iPadOS: 18.0
Bonjour service: _screenharbor._tcp
Signaling ports: 9471 plain, 9473 TLS
Data port: 9472
URL scheme: screenharbor://action/{start,stop,restart}
Status snapshot: ~/Library/Application Support/ScreenHarbor/host.widget.snapshot.json
